active_continuity: Butler Kim traced the Black Hunter “tail” to Im Yeongjun, a Level 95 A-rank Hunter living under the identity of a wealthy rural resident.
The group suspects Im Yeongjun's biweekly village feasts conceal the supply chain for a Black Hunter training operation.
Twenty-eight Black Hunters were present or hiding at Im Yeongjun's mansion, including the three attackers who severed Im Kkeokjeong's arms.
Taekyung entered the protected mansion alone after deciding that human opponents trained to hunt people were within his specialty.
Im Yeongjun ordered the Black Hunters to kill Taekyung after Taekyung demanded the three attackers be surrendered and the rest disarm.
Taekyung fought the Black Hunters with White Flame, Spear Energy, internal energy, and copied martial techniques.
Taekyung killed numerous Black Hunters and forced the survivors to retreat into the mansion.
Im Yeongjun said the attack on Im Kkeokjeong was an order from an unnamed authority above him.
Im Yeongjun threatened Taekyung's mother and younger sister and offered to arrange his retirement as a compensated civilian.
Taekyung rejected compromise and chose the way of Murim over the modern approach.
Taekyung destroyed Im Yeongjun's shoulder with the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist and pursued him into the mansion.
Taekyung destroyed the mansion's layered defensive barriers and severely damaged the building with the Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist.
Taekyung confronted the surviving Im Yeongjun inside the ruined mansion and invoked Tendon-Splitting and Bone-Twisting.
open_questions: Which major Guild or powerful authority is backing Im Yeongjun and the Black Hunter operation?
Were the village feasts actually being used to procure supplies for the Black Hunter training operation?
What information will Im Yeongjun reveal after Taekyung begins questioning him?
temporary_decisions: Render 세 얼간이 as the Three Idiots.
Render 도사견 as Tosa dogs and 보신탕 as dog-meat soup.
Render 수강 as qi condensed around the hand.
Render 멸천신권 as Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist, distinct from 멸염신권 as Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.
Render 삼성의 공력 as three-tenths of internal energy in this chapter's context.
